decisions.reason: Management has already invested in and publicly presented this perfect binder, so escalation of commitment makes it likely to keep the product and attribute any weak demand to temporary causes.
As an automated variant tied to the firm's stated focus on automation and equipped with sunk costs, the firm is likely to persist and justify its earlier launch despite unclear market evidence.

This booklet maker fits the announced shift toward digital print finishing and integrated automation, making it central enough that dropping it would publicly expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
